default_assignees.description: Default assignee (organization member) by incident priority.

review_stages.description: Ordered review stages (at most 6, `a-z0-9_`) before a postmortem can be published.

sigma.description: One-step residual deviation of the fit.

ForecastAlgorithm.description: How a `forecast` rule projects its series.

ForecastCfg.description:
The `forecast` condition: breaches when any forecast point within `horizon_s` satisfies
`op value`.

truncated.description: More than 50 series matched; the rest were dropped.

forecast.description: Forecast points after the last sample, with a band of two residual deviations.

token.description: The `wto_` link token: in this response only. The public page is `/r/{token}`.

link_prefix.description: The link's prefix (never the token); null once revoked.

intro.description: Shown above the form (at most 2000 characters).

ends_at.description: RFC 3339, after `starts_at`, at most 90 days after it.

to.description: Who receives my pages. They must confirm before it applies.

accept_from.description: Confirm the rule that user made naming me.

oneOf.description: Set or replace my outgoing rule (it needs confirmation again).

mute_minutes.description: Mute myself for 15, 30, 60 or 120 minutes; manual pages still arrive.

user.description: The other user: the receiver of my rule, or the sender of an incoming one.

FrameIn.description: One query result: `series` (a metrics answer) or `columns` with `rows` (a table answer).

annotation_ids.description: Annotations with a `correction`: the span's input becomes `input`, the correction `expected`.

name.description: Defaults to the template name.

trace_ids.description: Every LLM call with a stored payload in these traces (32 hex chars each).

frontend.description: The manifest's `frontend` section (titles, options schema, app pages, `host_apis`).

latest_version.description: The newest installed version of this plugin in the org (an update when it differs).

sri.description: `sha384-<base64>` of the bundle; the loader refuses code that does not match.

last_session.description: The latest session that hit it, to open its replay.

extrapolated.description: True when a sampling rule drops events: counts are of the sampled events.

next_cursor.description: Always null: aggregates are not paged.

sample_rate.description: Product of the enabled sampling rules' rates (1 when none).

series.description: Cold vs warm invocation counts per minute.

cold_start_filter.description: Span-attribute filter that isolates cold starts.

logs.description: Log-search filter for this function's logs.

traces.description: APM filter for this function's traces.

FunctionStats.description: Merged per-function answer; the route fills the `last_issue` title.

trace_example.description: Hex trace id of the slowest sampled trace, empty when none.

template.description: The template a one-click create starts from.

GateConditions.description: Conditions of a gate; an absent one is not checked.

fail_on_insufficient_data.description:
Missing data (no traffic, no sessions) fails the gate instead of reporting
`insufficient_data`; default false.

max_error_rate.description: A rate, 0..1 (0.02 = 2 %): errors over requests. See `max_error_rate_pct` for percent.

max_new_issues.description: A count of issues first seen in the window.

oneOf.description: A custom `PromQL` objective, evaluated at the end of the window.
The remaining error budget of an SLO at the end of the window.

GatePromqlObjective.description: A `PromQL` expression and its bounds; a vector result is judged by its largest value.

passed.description: False when any rule breached. A skipped (out-of-branch) gate passes.

skipped.description: True when the gate did not apply to this branch.

oneOf.description: Breach when more than `max` tests flipped fail->pass on the commit.
Breach when more than `max` tests fail (quarantined excluded when set).
Breach when coverage is below `pct` (or no coverage was uploaded).

GateRule.description: One gate rule. `max` is an inclusive ceiling; a count above it breaches.

GateSloObjective.description: At least `min_remaining` (0..1) of the SLO's error budget is left.

created.description: Drafts added; zero when everything was already proposed (or decided).

services_scanned.description: Services with traffic in the window.

description.description: Plain-language description of what the judge should check.

save.description: Also create the dashboard (needs the edit permission).

target.description:
A service name, a team slug, or one of `postgres`, `redis`, `kafka`, `nginx`, `jvm`,
`nodejs`, `go`, `kubernetes`, `host`, `aws`.

dashboard.description: The saved dashboard when `save` was set.

spec.description: A dashboard spec; send it to `POST /dashboards` to keep it.

GeneratorOverrides.description:
Tempo's `metrics_generator` overrides, for what plays that role here: the built-in RED rollup
and the `metric` pipeline stages of the spanmetrics preset.

disable_red.description: New spans stay out of the RED rollup (`processors` without `span-metrics`).

histogram_buckets_ms.description:
Duration buckets of the spanmetrics preset in milliseconds; empty means its defaults
(`span_metrics.histogram_buckets`).

max_active_series.description:
Series a project's `metric` stages, and separately its RED rollup, may add per hour, per
worker; 0 means the platform's cap for stages and no cap for RED (`max_active_series`).

folder_meta.description: `_folder.json` / `folder.yaml` metadata found at the last sync.

readme.description: README found beside the manifest at the last sync.

truncated.description: More than 5000 GPUs: only the first were listed (the summary counts those).

id.description: `kind:label`; repeated calls of one tool share a node.

query.description: Omit when `X-Wt-Persisted-Query` names a stored query.

GroundTruthIn.description: A ground-truth label arriving after its inference.

ground_truth.description: A number or a label string or boolean; the newest per inference wins.

counts.description: Rows per top value in this bucket (values outside the top list are left out).

oneOf.description: Group by these label values; empty puts every alert of the route in one group.

labels.description: Group by these label values; empty puts every alert of the route in one group.

oneOf.description: Every distinct label set is its own group.

GroupCounts.description: Exact `count() GROUP BY field` over the whole range (no sampling).

buckets.description: Per-bucket counts of the top values; only for `timeseries` mode.

other.description: Rows whose value is not in `top` (the pie's remainder slice).

top.description: The `top_n` most common values, most common first.

alert_rule_ids.description: Ids of the group's alert rules, in rule order.

dropped.description: Annotations with no counterpart here, as `rules[i].annotations.key`.

unchanged.description: Nothing changed: the group was already stored as given.

days.description: Days of alerts to replay, 1 to 30 (default 7).

ungrouped.description: Alerts that rendered no grouping id (they keep label grouping).

stack_rules.description: Proposed stack rules (the saved fingerprint rules apply too).

version.description: Proposed version, 1 or 2 (default: the saved one).

changed.description: Fingerprints whose hash would change (new events would open or join another issue).

groups_before.description: Groups before and after: fewer after means issues would merge.

sampled.description: Distinct fingerprints of the last 24 hours looked at (one sample each, at most 200).

auto_merge_distance.description: `SimHash` bits (0 to 8) within which a new issue joins an open one; null = off.

stack_rules.description:
Stack-trace rules, one per line: matchers (`stack.function:`, `stack.module:`,
`stack.abs_path:`, `stack.package:`, `family:`, `app:`, `category:`, `!` negates) then
actions (`+app`, `-app`, `+group`, `-group`, optionally `^`/`v` prefixed, `category:`).

transition_from.description: While a transition runs: the previous version, also hashed so issues do not split.

version.description: Grouping algorithm, 1 or 2 (2 ignores the message when there are frames).

auto_merge_distance.description: 0 to 8; null or absent turns auto-merge off.

stack_rules.description: The whole stack rules text, at most 16 KiB and 50 rules.

transition_days.description: When `version` changes: days (0 to 90, default 14) during which both versions are hashed.

version.description: 1 or 2 (default: unchanged, 1 when never saved).

id.description: Position of the rule (0-based) as a string.

event_id.description:
Hex id of a stored event of the project (`GET /issues/{id}/events` lists them). Give this
or `issue_id`.

issue_id.description: Test against the newest event of this issue instead.

new_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint with the candidate rule tried first.

old_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint under the stored rules (64 hex characters).

growth_pct.description: Change over the four weeks in percent; `None` when there were no series then.

series.description: Series active in the last 24 h.

series_4w_ago.description: Series that already existed 28 days ago.

on.description: `request`, `response` or `both`. A flag blocks the call.

down_severity.description: A firing alert of at least this severity is `down`; a lower one is `degraded`.

error_rate_degraded.description: Error ratio (0 to 1) from which the target is `degraded`.

error_rate_down.description: Error ratio from which the target is `down`.

maintenance_as.description: Status while a maintenance window covers the target.

p95_ms_degraded.description:
p95 latency in milliseconds above which the target is `degraded`. Unset: a service
target takes the threshold of its latency SLO (`HealthInput::slo_p95`), others skip it.

stale_after_s.description: Telemetry older than this many seconds is stale.

HealthTokenCreated.description: Returned once, by create. `token` is never stored or shown again.

prefix.description: Not secret: identifies the token in lists.

job_service.description: Service whose logs and traces are shown (the monitor's service).

p95_ms.description: 95th percentile of the job's reported duration over the last 7 days (ms).

HeatRow.description: One row (thread, host, container, any label value) of a [`Heatmap`].

cells.description: Value per bucket, index `(t - t0_ms) / step_ms`.

data.description: At most 100, by start offset.

buckets.description: Every bucket of the range, empty ones included (at most 200).

change.description: `{attrs: {from, to}, name: {from, to}}`, or the shape the writer recorded.

remaining.description: Budget left over the month, negative once overspent.

sli.description: Good ratio of the month (1 without traffic).

months.description:
The last 12 calendar months (UTC), oldest first; the current one is partial. Months older
than the project's data retention have no traffic and read as a full budget.

Hours.description: On-call hours of one user in a report.

weekend_h.description: Saturday and Sunday in the user's time zone.

last_created.description: Time-off entries the last run created.

last_error.description: A fixed sentence, never vendor text.

last_state.description: `ok` or `failed`; null before the first run.

headers_ref.description:
`wt+secret://<store>/<path>#<key>` whose secret is a JSON object of request headers
(for example `{"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}`). Only the reference is stored; the worker
resolves it per run and never logs the value.

url.description:
`https` URL that receives `POST {input}` and answers `{output}`; checked at save and
again at connect time by the network guard.

owner_project_id.description: The project that owns the entry.

exposure.description: 0 nothing seen; at least 50 once any indicator was seen, plus up to 50 for the share seen.

result.description:
`{indicators: [{kind, value, label}], hits: [IocHit], indicators_truncated, range_clamped,
from_ms, to_ms}`.

source.description:
`text` (a report, an indicator list or a STIX 2.1 bundle in `text`), `url` (a report or
STIX bundle at `url`, https and public only) or `stored` (the project's feeds and manual list).

ips_outside_allowlist.description: Those source IPs the allowlist would refuse (always empty without an allowlist).

rotate_overlap_hours.description: What rotation does: the old secret keeps working for this many hours.

rotate_preview.description: Plain-language preview of rotating this credential.

source_ips.description: Source IPs seen in audit events over the last 30 days (at most 20).

stale.description: Never used, or not used for 30 days.

resource_id.description: The identity principal (user, role, access key arn).

config.description: Public settings of the kind (never the secret).

has_decryption_key.description: SAML: whether a dedicated decryption key is stored.

has_secret.description: Whether the sealed secret (SP key or bind password) is stored.

login_path.description: Where members start sign-in (`GET`, or `POST` with credentials for LDAP).

metadata_path.description: SAML only: the SP metadata to give the `IdP`.

config.description:
Kind settings. saml: `idp_entity_id`, `idp_sso_url`, `idp_slo_url`, `idp_certs` (PEM),
`metadata_xml` or `metadata_url` (filled in from `IdP` metadata), `sp_cert_pem`,
`want_assertions_signed`, `allow_idp_initiated`, `force_authn`, `email_attr` (matches the
attribute's `Name`, never `FriendlyName`, as `groups_attr` does), `allow_sha1` (legacy:
accepts SHA-1 digests and signatures, which can be forged with effort; leave off),
`allow_encrypted_assertions` (off by default; RSA decryption of unauthenticated input, see
RUSTSEC-2023-0071; TLS already protects the POST; needs `decryption_secret` and
`sp_decryption_cert_pem`). The `IdP` must send a stable `NameID`
(persistent or email that is never reassigned); transient is refused. ldap: `url`
(`ldaps://` or `ldap://`), `start_tls`, `allow_plain`, `ca_pem`, `bind_dn`, `user_base_dn`,
`user_filter` (with `{username}`), `email_attr`, `member_of_attr`, `group_base_dn`,
`group_filter` (with `{dn}`), `timeout_secs`. jwt: `jwks_url`, `issuer`, `audience`,
`header`, `login_claim`, `email_claim`, `url_login`. proxy: `header`, `email_header`,
`groups_header`, `trusted_proxies` (CIDRs). github: `client_id`, `host` (GitHub Enterprise
Server base URL; default github.com), `allowed_orgs`, `allowed_teams` (`org/team-slug`; at
least one entry between them), with the client secret as `secret`; mappings match org names
and `org/team-slug`.

decryption_secret.description:
SAML: the RSA key (PEM) that decrypts assertions, sealed like `secret` and never returned.
Must differ from the signing key. Omit on update to keep the stored one.

default_role.description: Role of users in no mapped group: `engineer` or `read_only` (default).

groups_attr.description: Attribute, claim or header naming the groups (default `groups`; LDAP `memberOf`).

kind.description: `saml`, `ldap`, `jwt`, `proxy` or `github`; ignored on update (the kind never changes).

secret.description:
saml: the SP private key (PEM); ldap: the bind password. Sealed, never returned. Omit on
update to keep the stored one.

message.description: What was checked or what failed (never a secret).

service.description: The `service` value the findings are listed under.

skipped.description: SBOM entries with no OSV ecosystem (rpm, generic, no purl, ...).

sbom.description: A `CycloneDX`, SPDX or Syft JSON document.

target.description:
The image reference (`registry/app:1.4`) or host name; findings carry it as
`service = <kind>:<target>`.

oneOf.description: Cloud cost per hour (effective cost over day-wide windows).
Log records per hour.

partial.description: The window after the deploy has not fully elapsed.

services.description: Spans, logs and errors per hour of each service before and after the deploy.

status.description: `ok`, or `insufficient_data` when an ingest incident overlaps the windows (nothing is compared).

unavailable.description: Sections that could not be read.

oneOf.description: LCP p75 in milliseconds.

affected_sessions.description:
Sessions whose page loads carried a trace of a call made after the change; open each as a
replay.

oneOf.description: The prompt's calls since the change; absent without calls.
The prompt's calls just before the change; absent without calls.

incident_id.description: The incident the service is impacted by.

clashes.description: Existing names the import would overwrite, as `receiver:<name>` or `time_interval:<name>`.

dropped.description: Paths of everything left out, secrets first: enter them on the receivers.

email.description: Matched to a project member by email, case-insensitive.

ics.description: The calendar; its first recurring event becomes the layer. At most 256 KiB.

members.description: Users (`usr_…`) rotated once per occurrence, in order.

result.description:
When finished: `output` (the plan text), `report` (mapped, imported and skipped items) and
`markdown`.

dry_run.description: Report what would happen and write nothing.

entries.description: At most 1000 entries, as read from the HR system by the importer.

requires_approval.description: A run waits for a human to approve it.

mean_mttr_s.description: Mean seconds from declaration to resolution; null when none resolved.

partial.description: True when `ClickHouse` was unavailable: lost sessions and wasted spend count as 0.

service.description: Which of the incident's services to chart (default: the first).

snapshot.description: The expiring snapshot link; its token is shown once.

acked_at.description: When the incident first left triage.

impacted_business_services.description: Business services that list one of the incident's services (single-incident reads only).

kind.description:
`real`, `test` (a drill), `tutorial` or `retrospective`; only `real` counts in analytics,
cost and SLA reports.

labels.description: Key/value labels; filter the list with `?label=key=value`.

last_update_at.description: The last status change or posted update (the SLA cadence clock).

min_severity.description: Only incidents at least this severe (`SEV1` most severe); any when unset.

status.description: Only incidents in this status; any when unset.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters.

a_lead_s.description: Seconds before the incident version A fired (negative: after); null when it did not.

direction.description: `out`: the incident read is the link's source ("was caused by", "duplicates"); `in`: its target.

stopped_pages.description: The incident's pages that were open and are now stopped.

runbook_followed.description: A runbook run attached to that incident was worked to the end.

name.description: 1 to 80 characters; the stream's title is `<incident title> / <name>`.

roles.description: Roles of the stream itself (at most 20). Default: the caller as `lead`.

fields.description: Merged into the stored fields; `null` clears one.

labels.description: Replaces the labels (string values; at most 32).

IndexCandidate.description: A missing index suggested by a plan.

reason.description: Why: the node that scans the table without an index.

ddl.description: One `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY …;` statement (from `index_candidates` of the explain).

installation_id.description: A GitHub or GitLab installation of this project.

repo.description: `owner/name`; one of the installation's repositories for this project.

feed_id.description: The feed it came from; null for the manual list.

next_cursor.description: Present while more indicators remain.

features.description:
At most 200 `{name: number | string | boolean}`; numbers drift by quantile-bin PSI and KS,
strings and booleans by category PSI.

ground_truth.description: The true value when already known (same types as `prediction`).

inference_id.description: 1 to 128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . - / :`; ground truth is matched by it.

prediction.description: A number (regression) or a label string or boolean (classification).

score.description: The model's confidence or raw score.

ts.description: RFC 3339; default now. Not older than the project's trace retention, at most an hour ahead.

InfoPoint.description: A business value read from a span attribute (`AppDynamics` information point).

attr.description: Span attribute holding a number, e.g. `order.amount`.

action_id.description: Absent when the kind has no enabled playbook: advice only.

subject.description: The resource: host, pod, function, certificate host.

data_may_be_lost.description:
`true` when data this project sent in the window for the listed signals may not have been
stored. Re-send it if you can: delivery is at-least-once and the pipeline de-duplicates.

from.description: Start of the overlap of the incident with the query range (RFC 3339).

loss_risk.description: `likely` while the state is `down` (writes were refused or dropped), `possible` while `degraded`.

ongoing.description: `true` while the incident is still open.

reason.description: Customer-facing reason, for example `ingest broker disk is 100% full`.

to.description: End of the overlap; the end of the range while the incident is open.

data.description: Incident windows overlapping the range, oldest first.

ended_at.description: RFC 3339; null while the incident is open.

IngestLimitsBody.description: A project's ingest caps; an absent field uses the gateway default.

grace_burst.description: Extra bucket records per signal, absorbing bursts.

label_allowlist.description: Metric name to the only label names kept on its points.

warn_pct.description: Percent of the quota at which `X-WT-Quota-Warning` is sent.

effective.description: Defaults filled in: what the gateway applies.

IngestSettingsDto.description: Per-project profile ingest settings; 0 = no project limit (the built-in caps still hold).

include_stripped_profiles.description: Show those stripped profiles in query results.

keep_stripped_profiles.description: Keep a sampled-out profile as its totals with stacks and labels stripped (`__sampled__`).

max_profile_bytes.description: Largest accepted upload (compressed bytes, at most 8 MiB).

max_query_length_s.description: Longest query range in seconds (422 above it).

max_query_lookback_days.description: Queries see at most this many days back (on top of retention).

max_query_parallelism.description: Profile queries of the project running at once across all API instances; more wait, then 429.

max_stack_depth.description: Deeper stacks are cut at the root (at most 256).

reject_newer_than_s.description: Profiles further than this many seconds in the future are rejected.

reject_older_than_s.description: Profiles older than this many seconds are rejected.

relabel_rules.description: Prometheus `relabel_config` rules on sample labels (`service_name` readable).

sampling.description: `[{service_glob, ratio}]`: keep that share of the matching services' profiles.

kept.description: Spans that survived the gateway's head sampling.

incidents.description: Incidents that were open at any time in the last 7 days, newest first.

since.description: Start of the open incident, else the end of the latest one; null when none in 7 days.

state.description: `ok`, or the state of the open incident (`degraded` or `down`).

linked.description: Linked panels follow the powerpack (default); false inserts a detached copy.

pin.description: Linked only: pin the inserted version instead of following the latest.

section.description: Section (row or tab) id to put the panels in.

values.description: Variable values; a variable left out takes its default.

version.description: The version to insert; default the current one.

y.description: Top row of the group; default below every panel.

kind.description:
`spike`, `dip`, `level_shift`, `multi_metric`, `population`, `forecast_breach`,
`new_pattern` (a log pattern first seen in the last 15 minutes) or `faulty_deploy` (the
error rate rose after a deployment; `details.deployment_id`, `details.version`).

route.description: The API route that issued the query (empty for queries without a route tag).

sql.description:
The `ClickHouse` statement (at most 500 characters); values are bound parameters, so it
carries no user data.

user.description: The caller (a user or API key id).

error.description: Why the last pass failed, if it did.

first_data_at.description: Oldest data point seen (rollups keep 48 hours).

interval_s.description: The sweep runs every five minutes.

kinds.description: Insight kinds the sweep can open.

last_sweep_at.description: End of the last pass over this project; null before the sweep's first visit.

warming_up.description: True while no data has been seen or the learning period is still running.

warming_up_until.description: When the learning period ends (null until there is data).

existing.description: Titles that already existed and were left alone.

private.description: Visibility of the new repository (default private).

scaffold.description:
Also create the service's repository from the template's `template_repo` through the
project's GitHub or GitLab connection, named like the service, and set the entry's
`repo_url` to it.

service.description: Name of the new catalog service.

name.description: `^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}$`; routes refer to the interval by it.

report.description: The validated report with per-claim `status` (`supported|unsupported`); null until done.

id.description: The alert, issue, incident or release id (must be in the project) or a trace id.

text.description: Free text, at most 4,000 characters.

condition.description: `{severities, services, labels}`; an empty part matches anything.

kind.description:
`alert`, `slo_fast_burn`, `check_failure`, `issue_regression`, `incident_declared`, `llm_quality` or
`security_signal` (a high or critical SIEM signal's alert).

agent.description:
Run as this stored agent (`/ai/agents`): its tool bundle, budget and allowed actions. A
follow-up of an agent's run may hand over only to that agent or one of its peers.

parent_id.description: Follow-up of an earlier investigation in this project.

InvoiceLine.description: One invoice-preview line: a signal's volume priced with the project's configured rates.

services.description: Up to 5 services it was seen in.

IssueCodeLocation.description: Where a performance finding's spans ran (`code.*` span attributes) and the service's repository.

repo_url.description: The service's repository page (its repo link); null without one.

oneOf.description:
Performance issues (N+1, consecutive calls): the source location from the spans' `code.*`
attributes with the service's `repo_url`; absent when the spans carried none.

replays.description:
Up to 20 sessions of the issue's error events, newest first, with replay links from
`settings/product-analytics` (url null without that setting).

oneOf.description:
Files the newest event's symbolication could not resolve (`count`, first `reason`);
absent when every frame resolved or the event has none.

IssueDetail.description: One issue with the sessions that hit it.

environment.description: Environment name of the issue's first event (same fill rules as `service`).

escalated_at.description: When the issue escalated (set while its substatus is `escalating`).

escalation_events.description: Events in the batch that escalated it.

service.description:
Service of the issue's first event. Null only for an old issue whose events are gone or
not yet seen again; `GET` of one issue fills it from its first event.

trace_id.description: Hex; all zeros when the event has no trace.

oneOf.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

oneOf.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

trace_id.description: The newest event of the issue that carries a trace; null when none does.

IssueFilter.description: Which issues an issue rule counts; empty lists match everything.

age_min_s.description: Only issues first seen at least this many seconds ago (Sentry's "issue is older than").

assignee.description: `unassigned`, `assigned`, a user id (`usr_…`) or a team id (`team_…`).

latest_release.description:
Only issues first seen in the project's newest release; per-issue kinds also count only
that release's events (Sentry's "latest release").

min_times_seen.description: Only issues seen at least this many times in total.

tags.description:
The issue's events in the window must carry every one of these tags (Sentry's "event's
tags match"); at most 10.

IssuePct.description: Percent change of a per-issue count against the window before it.

min_prev.description: Issues with fewer than this in the previous window are skipped (default 1).

oneOf.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

oneOf.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

first_seen.description: RFC 3339 time of the session's first error in this issue.

url.description: Replay link from `settings/product-analytics`; null without that setting or any session id.

oneOf.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

oneOf.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

default_value_patterns.description:
Mask emails, card numbers, JWTs, bearer and known-prefix tokens and `password=` pairs in
error text and log bodies (default true).
