The issue with the most occurrences; merge the others into it with
`POST /issues/{target}/merge` (undone with `split`).

sources.description: Issues merged into this one and removed (1 to 100).

oneOf.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

oneOf.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

MessagingStat.description: One destination and operation, summed over the range.

lag_p50_ms.description: Span start minus the start of the linked producer span.

lag_samples.description: Spans whose link to a producer span gave a lag; the percentiles are 0 when this is 0.

cost_units.description: Estimated stored megabytes; the unit the cost pages compare.

unused.description: No query referenced the metric in the window.

series.description: Active series of this metric in the window.

unit.description: UCUM-style unit (`ms`, `By`, `1`, `{request}`); empty when the sender gave none.

rules.description:
1 to 100 rules. A rule whose `metric_match` and `kind` already exist replaces that rule's
spec; others are created.

spec.description:
`tags`: `{keep|drop: [labels]}`; `aggregate`: `{window, by, fn, drop_original}`;
`allow_labels`: `{labels: [labels]}` (keep only these, drop the rest at ingest).

MetricSeries.description: One series of a range result in the native response.

secret.description: Write-only bearer token sent to the source. Never returned.

tenant_id.description:
Tenant sent as `X-Scope-OrgID` on every read and ruler write (multi-tenant Mimir or
Cortex). Plain config, shown in reads.
The new tenant; null or empty clears it.

status.description: HTTP status the source answered, if it answered.

alert_rules.description: Alert rules and dashboards whose definition names the metric (at most 50 each).

edited.description: Type, unit and description come from a hand-set override (`PUT /metrics/metadata/{metric}`).

labels.description: Labels with the most distinct values first (at most 50).

saved_queries.description: Saved metric queries (the caller's and the project's shared ones) that name the metric.

type.description: `counter`, `gauge`, `histogram` or `summary`; empty when the sender declared none.

tag_rule_id.description: The `tags` rule that configures this metric, if any.

indexed.description: The metric's tag rule keeps it (queryable).

queried.description: A query, alert rule or dashboard used it in the window.

queries.description: References by queries and definitions in the window.

values_indexed.description: Distinct stored values (last 24 h); 0 when a tag rule drops the label.

est_bytes_saved_monthly.description: Stored bytes per 30 days no longer kept, from the series share.

est_usd_saved_monthly.description: That at the project's storage rate.

keep.description: The suggested allowlist: the labels queries used (`service` and `env` are always kept).

rule.description: The body to send to `metric-rules/bulk` (or `metric-rules`) to apply it.

tag_rule_id.description: The `tags` rule the suggestion replaces, if one matches.

next_cursor.description: Set while more suggestions remain; pass it as `cursor` for the next page.

series_saved.description: Series a tag rule keeps out of the index.

tag_rule_id.description: The `tags` rule that configures this metric, if any.

next_cursor.description: Set while more metrics remain; pass it as `cursor` for the next page.

MetricUsageRow.description: One metric's volume and query use.

last_queried.description: Last day it was queried (`YYYY-MM-DD`), empty when not in the window.

queries.description: Queries, alert rules and dashboards that read the metric in the window.

series_indexed.description: Series stored and queryable (active in the last 24 h).

series_ingested.description: Series as received in the last 24 h, before tag rules (equals `series_indexed` without one).

data.description: Other metrics, the largest absolute Pearson `r` first.

target_points.description: Buckets of the target metric that had samples.

truncated.description: More than 400,000 bucket rows matched: late metrics (by name) are missing.

queued.description: Queued for ingest, where series caps and metric limits can still refuse them.

skipped_out_of_range.description: Older than the project's metric retention or more than 10 minutes ahead.

oneOf.description: The range actually queried, when it differs from the requested one.

series.description: Durations are in seconds, rates per second.

truncated.description: More rows or series (100) existed than were read: values are lower bounds.

oneOf.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

oneOf.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

active_series_custom_trackers.description: Named series selectors whose active series are counted (Mimir custom trackers).

cost_attribution_labels.description:
Labels (at most 4) whose values usage is attributed to: received and discarded samples
and active series per value (`GET /v1/projects/{prj}/metrics/cost-attribution`).

created_timestamp_zero_ingestion.description: Write a 0 sample at the start time of a cumulative counter when the series begins.

creation_grace_period_s.description: Samples newer than now plus this are refused (seconds, 0: no bound).

enable_delayed_name_removal.description:
Prometheus 3 `promql-delayed-name-removal` (Mimir `enable_delayed_name_removal`): keep
`__name__` through functions until the end of the query, so `label_replace` and
`by (__name__)` still see it. Off by default, as in Prometheus.

max_cost_attribution_cardinality.description: Distinct value combinations tracked; the rest count as `__overflow__`.

max_fetched_samples_per_query.description: Samples one query may read from storage; the read stops there (0: no limit).

max_fetched_series_per_query.description: Series one query may read from storage; the read stops there (0: no limit).

max_native_histogram_buckets.description: Buckets per native histogram; wider ones are reduced in resolution (0: no limit).

max_query_lookback_s.description: How far back a query may read (seconds, 0: retention only).

max_samples_per_query.description: Points one range query may return.

max_total_query_length_s.description: Longest `end - start` of a range query (seconds, 0: retention only).

out_of_order_time_window_s.description:
Samples older than the newest sample of their series by more than this are refused
(seconds, 0: any order accepted).

past_grace_period_s.description: Samples older than now minus this are refused (seconds, 0: no bound).

promote_resource_attributes.description:
Resource attributes copied onto every series of the resource (besides `service`, `env`,
`instance`, `host_name`).

replica_labels.description:
Thanos `--query.replica-label` (MET-017): on the native range route, series equal except
for one of these labels are HA replicas and collapse into one (the replica with the fewest
gaps per step); `dedup=false` on a request turns it off. Empty: no query-time dedup.

target_info.description: Write one `target_info` series per resource (its attributes as labels), for `info()`.

active_series.description: Series seen in the last 20 minutes.

rule_samples_per_second.description: Of those, written by recording rules.

samples_per_second.description: Samples per second over the last minute, by sample time.

config.description: The v2 config (`groups`, `sources`) with the same behavior; create a version from it.

version.description: The version to convert (default: the active one).

seconds_from_declared.description: Seconds since the incident was declared.

baseline_s.description: Drift baseline: the seconds before the window, 3600 to 31 days (default 7 days).

feature.description: Drift of this feature only (`@prediction` for the prediction).

labels.description: Classification only: per label over the whole range.

next_cursor.description: Always null: at most 500 models are listed.

label.description: A name shown in the device list, e.g. "Ana's iPhone" (at most 100 characters).

token.description: The device token from APNs (hex) or FCM (32 to 4096 characters).

service.description: The service a quick declare mobilizes when none is named; null clears it.

enabled.description: Turned on for this project.

config_defaults.description: Settings for the agent's own config file (credentials are placeholders).

kind.description: The wt-agent module that collects the product.

groups.description: Groups the monitor sees on stored data now.

note.description: Why it was not evaluated (managed kind, too many, invalid, no query slot).

MonitorConfigDoc.description:
What `config` holds, by `kind`. Kinds without a schema here (udp, icmp, smtp, ...) take the
fields of their probe driver; a wrong key is a 422 that lists the accepted ones.

dnssec.description: Ask for DNSSEC validation and report the AD flag.

expect.description: Answers that must all be present.

name.description: The name to resolve.

oneOf.description:
Can an alert about this monitor reach someone: `ready`, and in `missing` what lacks (no
route, no deliverable target, `alert=false`). Same content as the deprecated `alerting`.
Not whether the monitor is firing: that is `status`. Set on reads.

Whether a page about this monitor can be delivered: `{ready, missing[]}`. Despite the name
it does not say the monitor is firing; it means "can alert". Deprecated alias of
`alert_readiness`, kept for existing clients. Set on reads.

The canary running now (a deploy marker opened it for a monitor with `deploy_canary`, or
`POST .../canary` did); null when none. Set on reads.

config_error.description:
Why the engine cannot run the monitor (for example an assertion that does not parse); the
monitor raises no alert while it is set.

oneOf.description:
The newest check result (any location); null when there is none in the last 7 days. Set
on reads.

last_run_at.description:
When the newest check result arrived (RFC 3339); null when there is none in the last 7
days. Set on reads.

rule_id.description: The managed alert rule, when `alert` is set.

status.description:
`paused` (disabled), `up` or `down` by the newest result, `unknown` without one. Set on
reads.

warnings.description:
On create with `alert: true`: why a page about the monitor would go nowhere (no route
matches, no deliverable target). The monitor is created anyway.

missing.description: Sections that could not be read.

replays.description: Sessions with errors or frustration on the monitor's route around the failure.

MonitorHeartbeatConfig.description:
`kind: heartbeat`: a push monitor that waits for check-ins (`POST /v1/checkins/{slug}`).
`interval_s` on the monitor is ignored; the schedule decides.

failure_threshold.description: Failed runs in a row before the monitor is down, 1 to 100.

grace_s.description: Seconds a check-in may be late before the monitor is down, 0 to 86400.

max_runtime_s.description: A started run that does not finish within this is a failure, 1 to 86400 (null: no limit).

recovery_threshold.description: Good runs in a row before it recovers, 1 to 100.

slug.description: 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`; the check-in URL names it.

crontab.description: Five fields (or six with a leading `0`, or `@daily` and the like).

interval_s.description: A check-in is due every this many seconds, 10 to 2678400.

tz.description: IANA time zone of `crontab` (default UTC); not with `interval_s`.

MonitorHttpConfig.description: `kind: http`. Credentials never go here: use `auth` with `password_ref` / `token_ref`.

auth.description: `{type: basic|bearer|negotiate, username, password_ref, token_ref, realm, kdc, spn}`.

cache_bypass.description: Add a cache-busting query parameter to each request.

client_cert_secret.description: `{{secret.NAME}}`: a PEM client certificate and key.

headers.description:
Header values are write-only: `***` or null keeps the stored value. No `Authorization`,
`Proxy-Authorization` or `Cookie` here.

url.description: `http://` or `https://`, at most 2048 bytes, no credentials in it.

MonitorSpec.description: Everything about a monitor that a user sets.

alert.description:
Whether alerting is enabled for this monitor (default true): config, not current state.
True creates the managed alert rule; read `status` for whether the monitor is up or down.

alert_kind.description:
What the managed rule watches (default `check_failed`: the round fails quorum). A
heartbeat always uses `check_failed`.

assertions.description: Gatus-style conditions, for example `[STATUS] == 200`. All must hold.

config.description:
Driver config, by `kind`: `MonitorHttpConfig`, `MonitorTcpConfig`, `MonitorDnsConfig`,
`MonitorTlsConfig` or `MonitorHeartbeatConfig` (the other kinds take their driver's
fields). `http` for example: `url`, `method`, `headers`, `body`, `max_redirects` (0 to
10), `tls_verify`, `ip_version` (`4` or `6`), `auth`. An unknown key is a 422 that lists
the accepted ones. Credentials never go here.

consecutive_failures.description:
Alert config, not live state (read `status`): with `alert_kind` `consecutive_failures`, the failed
rounds in a row that fire the alert, 2 to 100 (default 3).

declare_incident.description: Open an incident, linked to the monitor, when the rule fires.

degraded_ms.description: A passing check slower than this is degraded, not down.

deploy_canary.description:
Opt in to the deploy canary (default false): after a deploy marker (`change_events` kind
`deploy`) lands, the monitor runs every 10 s for 5 minutes (below the plan's
`check_min_interval_s` on purpose, so use it on monitors that tolerate the load). The
results are flagged `canary` and still alert; uptime leaves them out. The running canary
shows as `canary` on the monitor.

kind.description:
One of the check kinds, `heartbeat` included (see the `MonitorHeartbeatConfig` schema for
its config).

min_availability_pct.description: `availability`: alert below this percent of up results, 50 to 99.999 (default 99).

recovery_threshold.description:
Successful rounds in a row that resolve a firing alert, 1 to 100 (default 1). Applies to
every `alert_kind` of a probed check; a heartbeat sets its own in its config.

regression_factor.description:
`performance_regression`: alert when the phase is this many times slower than its last
day's mean, 1.1 to 20 (default 2).

renotify_s.description: Re-notify an open alert every this many seconds (60 to 604800); a rule label for routes.

service.description: Catalog service the monitor belongs to.

oneOf.description: Severity of the managed rule (default `high`).

stop_after.description: Stop notifying after this many notifications (1 to 100); a rule label like `renotify_s`.

timeout_ms.description: 100 to 60000 (browser: 120000) and at most the interval (default 10000).

evidence.description: Why: hours and requests read, the observed p99 / p95, the current and proposed value.

kind.description: `create` (a new rule) or `tune` (a new threshold for `rule_id`).

spec.description: The rule a `create` would make; the rule's name for `tune`.

expect.description: Substring the first bytes from the target must contain.

coverage_24h.description:
How much of the window the uptime figure covers, 0 to 1: the time from the first counted
round in the window to now, over the window's length. A monitor created 58 minutes ago has
0.04 for 24 h. Approximate: gaps after the first round are not subtracted. 0 without data.

insufficient_data.description:
True when the 30 d window holds fewer than 100 counted rounds (the SLO budget route's
rule: fewer than 100 events), so the percentages are not meaningful yet.

locations.description: The newest result of each location (last 24 hours).

uptime_24h.description:
Fractions 0 to 1: up rounds over rounds that are neither maintenance nor canary. Null
when the window holds no such round (never 1.0 for "no data").

folder_id.description: `null` moves the dashboard to the top level.

org_id.description: The target org; the caller must be `org_admin` of both orgs.

pct.description: Percent change; null when the previous week was zero.

managed_by.description: `integration:<pack>` while an integration pack owns the rule (PUT and DELETE answer 409).

oneOf.description: The next newer event of the issue.
The next older event of the issue.
The event of the window with the most context (release, user, trace, type, value).

outcome.description: Status or state of the document (`resolved`, `published`, ...).

resolution.description: Root cause or resolution text when the document has one.

score.description: 0 to 1.1: `1 - distance / 64` plus up to 0.1 for shared services.

NetPath.description: A traced path (one route of a TCP/UDP trace, or the ICMP trace).

unified.description: Unified diff with line numbers in the hunk headers.

body.description: Secrets already redacted by the agent.

updated_at.description: When the startup config last changed.

changed.description: True when running holds changes not saved to startup.

unified.description: Unified diff from startup (`---`) to running (`+++`).

changed.description: False when the hash equals the stored startup config.

id.description: Investigation id; poll `GET /v1/projects/{prj}/investigations/{id}` for the summary.

from.description: Older version; omit it to compare `to` with the device's startup config.

changed.description: False when the hash equals the latest version; nothing is stored then.

oneOf.description: The newest path in the range, if an agent traces this host.

duration_hours.description: How long the access should last, 1 to 720 hours.

reason.description: Why the access is needed (at most 1000 characters).

config.description: `{interval?, modules: {<name>: <module config>}}`.

mapping.description:
Generic: `{"preset": name}` or a mapping (`title` or `rules` required; optional
`signature` makes the source accept signed posts without a key). Email: optional mapping
plus `extract` parse rules; `{}` uses the email preset.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters, unique in the project.

signed.description:
Email only: `POST /v1/inbound/email/{token}` then needs an HMAC signature; the response
carries the `signing_key` once.

channel.description: Release lane (`stable`, `preview` or `fast`); default every org.

allowed_cidrs.description: Only these addresses may use the key (at most 50 CIDRs; empty: any).

project_id.description: Restrict the key to one project (`prj_...`) of this org.

oneOf.description:
`general` (default) or `mcp`; investigation and eval keys are minted internally and answer
422 here.

read_only.description: A read-only key answers 403 `read_only_key` to anything but GET and HEAD.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the key expires, 1 to 365. Defaults to 90.

name.description: Letters, digits and `_`; used as `#name`.

source_url.description: `https://` only; private addresses are refused when it is fetched.

rule_ids.description: 1 to 20 rule ids of the project.

ref.description: The object's id (a trace id is 32 hex characters), or an https URL.

title.description: Shown instead of the default label (at most 300 characters).

assignee.description: A user id of a project member.

oneOf.description: Open the case from this alert, issue, incident or insight (linked as the first link).

title.description: Required unless `from` is given (its title is the default).

mapping.description: Optional `{"service": "...", "env": "..."}` defaults for events that carry neither.

repo.description: Repository or pipeline label (informational; events carry their own).

config.description: Non-secret settings (project, regions, metric lists, zone ids).

interval_s.description: Pull interval in seconds, at least 60 (default 300).

name.description: 1 to 100 characters.

cron.description: Five-field cron (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week).

enabled.description: Default true.

env_id.description: Environment the pulled records are stamped with.

kind.description: `http_pull`: GET `config.url` (https only) and store each line as a log.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters, unique in the project.

oneOf.description: Write-only bucket credentials; send these or `credentials_ref`.

kind.description:
`focus`, `aws_cur`, `azure_export`, `gcp_export`, `openai`, `anthropic`, `aws_ce`,
`azure_cost` or `gcp_billing`. LLM bills and the three cloud billing APIs (Cost Explorer,
Cost Management, `BigQuery` export) take `credentials_ref` to a secret and no bucket.

repull_days.description:
LLM bill sources: finished days read again on every pass so provider revisions replace
the stored day (1-30, default 3).

allowed_cidrs.description:
Only these addresses may ingest with the credential (at most 50 CIDRs; empty: any).
The gateway judges the TCP peer address; only when that peer is in `WT_TRUSTED_PROXIES`
does it take the right-most `X-Forwarded-For` hop that is not itself a trusted proxy.
Behind a reverse proxy, list the proxy there, or every client looks like the proxy. A
client on the gateway's own host arrives from the proxy or container-bridge address,
not the host's public IP, so pin it to that address.

oneOf.description: Per-key limits checked before the project quota (0 = inherit).

scopes.description:
At least one; an OTLP exporter sending all three signals needs `ingest:traces`,
`ingest:logs` and `ingest:metrics`.

actions.description: Action names the role may perform (see `GET /v1/projects/{prj}/me` for the vocabulary).

spec.description:
Dashboard spec v1. Stored verbatim too, so GET returns the same key order. Its JSON Schema
is at `GET /v1/projects/{prj}/dashboards/spec-schema`.

title.description: Also accepted as `name`, the display-name field most other create APIs use (B14).

region.description: Free-form region label shown in the console, for example `eu-central-1`.

preview.description: Count the matching rows and create nothing.

signals.description:
Any of `logs`, `traces`, `errors`, `rum`, `replay`, `profiles` (all but `logs` and
`traces` only for `user`). `rum` and `replay` match the subject's sessions: the id is
hashed server-side the way the browser SDK hashes it, and replay recordings are queued for
deletion from object storage. The request's steps list every store covered.

oneOf.description: Required for `user`.

external_id.description:
Your id for this deployment, unique per `source`. Posting it again returns the same
deployment, so retries are safe.

service.description:
The service shipped (a catalog service name). Required unless the release version reads
`<service>@<version>`, from which it is derived (422 naming `service` otherwise). DORA
groups deployments by it, and rollback detection compares deployments of one service.

started_at.description: RFC 3339; default `finished_at` when given, else now.

status.description:
`started`, `succeeded` or `failed` (default `succeeded`). A terminal status without
`finished_at` defaults it to now.

version.description: Version of the release; created (no commits) when it does not exist yet.

config.description:
Non-secret settings. `s3`: `bucket`, `region`, `endpoint` (https), `prefix`, `format` (`ndjson` default or `parquet`). `kafka`:
`brokers` (`host:port` list) and `topic`. `otlp_http`: `url` (https). `prometheus_remote_write`: `url` (https).
`kafka` topics must start with `wt-export.`.

credentials_ref.description:
`wt+secret://<store>/<path>#<key>` in place of `secret`: the worker reads the
same JSON object from the external store at delivery. Only `vault`, `file` and `env`
stores work here (422 `unsupported_in_this_service` otherwise).

failover_order.description: Position in the group's failover order (lower first), 0 to 255.

filter.description:
Optional expression (the pipeline `expr` language); only records for which it is not
`false` are exported.

group.description: Failover group name (1 to 64 chars). Members of a group share one stream of jobs.

kind.description:
`s3`, `kafka`, `otlp_http`, `prometheus_remote_write` (metrics only), `splunk_hec`, `loki`,
`elasticsearch`, `webhook`, `syslog`, `gcs`, `azure_blob`, `datadog`, `kinesis`, `pubsub`,
`event_hubs`, `cloudwatch_logs`, `firehose`, `sqs`, `sns`, `azure_monitor_logs` or
`clickhouse`. Every config also takes `sample` (a fraction in (0, 1]
kept after the filter). Signals: `logs`, `traces`, `metrics`, `rum`, `profiles`, `errors`,
`replays`. `kinesis`: config `region`, `stream`; `cloudwatch_logs`: `region`, `log_group`,
`log_stream` (both: secret `access_key_id`, `secret_access_key`, `session_token`?).
`pubsub`: `project`, `topic`; secret `access_token` or `service_account`. `event_hubs`:
`namespace`, `hub`; secret `key_name`, `key` (a shared access policy with Send).
`firehose`: `region`, `delivery_stream`; `sqs`: `region`, `account_id`, `queue`; `sns`:
`region`, `account_id`, `topic` (AWS secret as above; `.fifo` names deduplicate).
`azure_monitor_logs`: `endpoint` (https data collection endpoint), `dcr_id`, `stream`;
secret `tenant_id`, `client_id`, `client_secret`. `clickhouse`: `url` (https), `database`,
`table` (columns `ts`, `signal`, `job_id`, `item`); secret `username`, `password`?.

secret.description:
Write-only. `s3`: `access_key_id`, `secret_access_key`. `otlp_http`: `headers` (name to
value). `kafka`: `username`, `password` (SASL/PLAIN over TLS). `prometheus_remote_write`: `bearer`
or `username` and `password`. Never returned.

weight.description: Weighted round-robin share inside the group, 1 to 100 (default 1).

credentials_ref.description: Name of a credential in the agent's local config.

interval_s.description: Poll interval in seconds, at least 300 (default 900).

spec.description:
Built-in: `{metric, ...}`; CEL: `{expr}`; code: `{language: javascript|typescript|python,
source, timeout_ms?}` where `source` defines `function score({input, output, expected,
metadata})` (Python: `def score(args)` over the same dict).

schedule_id.description: A whole schedule's feed; without it, a feed of the caller's own shifts in the project.

auth.description: Write-only: `user:password` for basic auth, otherwise a bearer token. Bound to `url`.

kind.description: `stix_url` (a STIX 2.1 bundle) or `taxii` (a TAXII 2.1 API root plus `collection`).

name.description: 1 to 64 characters, unique in the project.

url.description: `https`, resolving to public addresses only.

source.description: Optional git source, pulled every 60 s through the SSRF guard.

steps.description: 2 to 10 key transaction ids, in order.

config.description:
`s3`: `bucket`, `region`, `endpoint` (https), `prefix`. `webhook`: `url` (https).
`syslog`: `host`, `port` (TLS). `kafka`: `brokers`, `topic`, `tls` (required with SASL).

credentials.description:
Write-only. `s3`: `access_key_id`, `secret_access_key`. `webhook`: `secret` (HMAC key,
required). `kafka`: `username`, `password`, `sasl_mechanism` (`PLAIN` default,
`SCRAM-SHA-256`, `SCRAM-SHA-512`). Never returned.

env_id.description: `env_...` of this project. Unset: the token reads the whole project.

service.description: A service of the environment (needs `env_id`).

filter.description: Optional `wt-search` query narrowing the held rows (logs and traces).

count.description: Issues first seen after the deploy, inside the after-window, with this release as first release.

top.description: The five with the most events.

split.description: `train` (default), `validation`, `test` or any label of at most 32 characters.

panel.description: A dashboard panel object (its `id` and `grid` are the defaults for new links).

field.description: Attribute or label the rule applies to, e.g. `http.route` or `service.name`.

kind.description:
`logs`, `traces`, `metrics` or `profiles` (open that explorer with `template` as the
query) or `webhook` (a link action: `template` is an https URL).

label.description: Link text shown to the user.

template.description: Query text with `${value}` standing for the clicked value, or the webhook URL.

name.description: The part after `private:`.
Lowercase letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter (at most 63 characters).

body.description: 1 to 4000 characters of SQL, substituted for `{{name}}` before the query is checked.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter (at most 63).

end_at.description: RFC 3339, after `at`: a region instead of a marker.

tags.description: At most 10 tags of 1 to 40 characters.

text.description: 1 to 1,000 characters.

auth_token.description: The provider auth token (Twilio) or signature secret (Vonage). Sealed; never returned.

url.description: HTTPS download URL.

base_url.description: Twilio-compatible API origin other than the default (`https://` only).

from.description: The carrier number pages are sent from (E.164).

projects.description: `prj_` ids the token is limited to; omit for all the user's projects.

scopes.description:
Narrower than the user's role: `query:read`, `query:sql`, `admin:read`, `admin:write`.
Omit for no narrowing.

allow_private.description: Permit a private or loopback address (in-VPC peers). Audited.

base_url.description: Base URL of the remote API (https, public address).

credential.description: Write-only: a `service` API key of the remote cluster.

name.description: Used in federated queries (`peer`); unique per org.

dashboard_ids.description: Up to 50 dashboard ids, shown in this order (1 to 50 when `tags` is empty).

interval_s.description: Seconds each dashboard stays up, 5 to 3600 (default 30).

tags.description: Up to 10 tags; matching dashboards follow the listed ones.

predicates.description: 1 to 10 predicates, all of which must hold: `{field, op, values}`.

query.description:
Instead of `predicates`: a log-search style restriction such as `service:web env:prod
-level:debug` (AND-ed key:value terms only; see `predicates_from_query`).

env_id.description: Environment id (`env_…`) or name; `env` is accepted too.

message.description: Template over captured variables, e.g. `user {user.id} failed`.

dataplane_id.description: A `managed` data plane or one owned by the org; fixed for the project's lifetime.

default_alerting.description:
Default `true`: creates a "Project owners (email)" escalation policy and receiver that page
every owner and admin of the project by email, used by the default routing tree (no tree
is saved and the policy does not count toward the plan's escalation paths). `false` starts
the project with no receivers. Edit or delete them any time.

template.description: Version 1: a string (`text`) or `[{role, content}]` (`chat`) with `{{variable}}` placeholders.

default_role.description: Role of users in no mapped group: `engineer` or `read_only` (default).

env_id.description: Only deployments to this environment; default all.

name.description: Unique per project, 1 to 100 characters.

service.description: Service whose error rate and p95 are checked; without it those conditions have no data.

window_min.description: Minutes after the deployment before the gate is evaluated, 5 to 1440.

reviewers.description: User ids who may review without `ManageEvals`.

reviewers_per_item.description: Distinct reviewers who must complete each item, 1 to 10 (default 1).

rules.description:
Any of `score_below` (`{name, value}`), `has_negative_feedback` (bool) and `random_pct`
(0 to 100): a trace matching any key is queued once.

score_schema.description: Score names the UI offers: `[{name, type}]`.

commits.description:
At most 1000; each a sha string or `{sha, repo, timestamp}`. Known shas of an existing
release are kept.

version.description: Unique per project; posting it again returns the existing release.

kind.description:
`alert_digest` (noisiest rules of the previous period), `dashboard`, `slo` or `sla` (the
availability statement of the period just ended; formats `html`, `pdf`, `csv`),
`incident` (volume, severity and MTTR per team), `oncall` (MTTA, noise, burden), `dora`, `issues` (new and most frequent issues of the period) or `scorecard` (each service's latest custom-rule score and maturity level).

receiver_id.description: The receiver the report is delivered to.

rrule.description:
`FREQ=HOURLY`, `DAILY`, `WEEKLY` or `MONTHLY` with `BYHOUR`, `BYMINUTE`, `BYDAY` (weekly, or
monthly as `1MO`, `-1FR`) and `BYMONTHDAY` (monthly, `-1` is the last day). `DTSTART`
anchors `INTERVAL` above 1 and `COUNT`; `UNTIL` ends a rule. At least an hour between runs.

slo_ids.description: Kind `slo_group`: the SLOs the report covers, 1 to 50.

target_id.description: The dashboard to render or export (kind `dashboard`).

bake_s.description: Canary only: seconds to watch the canaries before judging them (10 to 86400, default 300).

canary_pct.description: Canary only: percent of matching agents that get the version first (1 to 99).

max_unhealthy_pct.description: Canary only: percent of canaries allowed to be unhealthy (0 to 50, default 10).

daily_job_cap.description: Jobs per UTC day (default 5000, at most 1,000,000).

sample_rate.description: Share of traces picked (default 1.0); the pick is a hash of the trace id.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters, unique in the org; workflow steps name it as `runner`.

NewSaKeyRequest.description:
Example: `{"name": "ci", "scopes": ["ci:write"], "expires_in_days": 90, "project_id": "prj_...", "env_id": "env_..."}`.
`project_id` and `env_id` are optional (`env_id` needs `project_id`) unless an `ingest:*` scope is requested.

env_id.description:
Limits the key to one environment (`env_`) of that project; needs `project_id`. Required
with an `ingest:*` scope.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the key expires, 1 to 365. Defaults to 90 when absent.

name.description: Required.

project_id.description:
Limits the key to this project (`prj_`, all its environments unless `env_id` is given); must
be a project of the account. Required with an `ingest:*` scope.

scopes.description:
Any of `ingest:logs|traces|metrics|errors|alerts|checkins`, `query:read`, `query:sql`,
`admin:read`, `admin:write`, `ci:write` (releases, deployments, test runs, artifacts),
`events:write` (post events), `monitors:write` (monitors, maintenance windows, triggers),
`privacy:execute` (the Cookie Munch privacy executor routes of a project), `slos:write`
(SLOs) and `bootstrap` (create projects and keys). Omit when `preset` is given.

receiver_id.description: Receiver notified with a link to each result. Needs `manage_alerts`, now and at every run.

rrule.description:
`FREQ=MINUTELY|HOURLY` with `INTERVAL`, or `FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY` with `BYHOUR`, `BYMINUTE`
and (weekly) `BYDAY`. At least 5 minutes between runs.

saved_query_id.description:
A saved query of kind `sql` or `logs` visible to the caller. A `lookback_s` (60 to
2678400, default 3600) in its `query` sets how far back each run reads.

view_name.description:
Makes this a scheduled view: each run's rows are also stored for SQL as the table
`view_<view_name>` (lowercase letters, digits, `_`; at most 63). A project holds at most
500 views; names are unique.

endpoint.description: Path of the SCIM base URL on this host; the `IdP` connector needs origin plus this.

secret.description: The full bearer token, shown once.

token.description: The same value as `secret`, under the name credentials and API keys use (B14).

credential.description:
Optional credential of the store itself (Vault token or approle secret, static cloud
keys). Sealed; never returned.

cases.description:
Ordered `[{condition|threshold, severity}]`; the first (highest threshold) match sets a
signal's severity.

detection.description:
One of the six detection methods; `params` holds what the method needs (`field`,
`indicator_fields`, `steps`, ...).

group_by.description: Log attributes that form a signal's entity (at most 10).

filters.description:
Required: `{min_priority, rules[], namespaces[]}`. `min_priority` defaults to `warning`;
empty `rules` / `namespaces` mean no restriction on that axis.

env_id.description:
Environment name (what `sentry-cli` sends as `environment`) or `env_…` id; a name is
created when the project does not have it.

name.description: Echoed back; not stored.

url.description: Echoed back; not stored.

version.description: Unique per project; posting it again returns the existing release.

auth.description: Write-only bearer token for the server (8 to 2048 ASCII characters, no whitespace).

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 24 characters.

url.description: `https` endpoint resolving to public addresses.

projects.description: `prj_` ids of this org; omit or `null` for all projects.

ttl_days.description: Days until the code stops working and is deleted, 1 to 3650 (default 365).

account.description: `azure`: the storage account that holds the inventory container.

oneOf.description: `gcp` and `azure`: the key, sealed and never returned.

data_region.description:
The region the inventoried data lives in, for list prices (default: `region`). `eu-west-1`,
`europe-west1`, `westeurope`; an unlisted region is priced at the provider's default.

fields.description:
`gcp` and `azure`: the report's columns in order (`gcp` default `bucket, name, size,
updated, storageClass`; `azure` default `Name, Last-Modified, Content-Length, AccessTier`).

inventory_bucket.description: The bucket (`azure`: the container) the inventory report is written to.

prefix.description: Where the reports sit in it, and for `aws` the key prefix of the inventoried bucket (optional).

provider.description: `aws` (S3 Inventory), `gcp` (Storage Insights inventory report) or `azure` (Blob Inventory).

role_arn.description: `aws`: the cross-account IAM role the worker assumes to read the report.

test_ids.description: Tests of this project, run in this order.

variables.description: Variables every test of the suite starts with.

slug.description:
Derived from the name when omitted (lower-cased, other characters become '-'; a clash
gets a `-2`, `-3`... suffix). 409 when given and taken.

mapping.description: GitHub login to email, for members whose profile email is private.

prune.description: Remove members the source no longer lists (default false: additive).

secret.description:
Credential (JSON); sealed, never returned. GitHub `{token}`; `ServiceNow` `{token}` or
`{user, password}`.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters, unique in the project.

spec.description: `{trigger: {http: {method, url, headers, body}}, variables, wait_for_trace_s, assertions}`.

user_id.description: Whose time off (`usr_…`); default the caller. Others' needs `ManageOnCall`.

location_id.description: A private location of this project.

apdex_t_ms.description: Apdex threshold T in milliseconds, 1 to 600000 (default 500).

match.description: Attribute matchers, all of which must hold on the same span (at most 20).

condition.description: Default: matches every event of the kind.

enabled.description: Default true.

restart.description:
Host targets: restart the instrumented services after the switch. Takes effect only on
agents whose own config allows restarts (`autoinst.allow_restart`).

target_version.description: The auto-instrumentation version to apply, for example `2.32.0`.

audience.description: The `aud` the workload's token must carry.

claims.description: Further claims that must equal these strings, for example `{"tid": "..."}`.

issuer.description: Required for `aws` and `oidc`; fixed for `gcp` and `azure`.

jwks_uri.description: Required for `aws` and `oidc`; fixed for `gcp` and `azure`.

provider.description: `aws`, `gcp`, `azure` or `oidc` (Kubernetes and any other OIDC issuer).

subject.description: The `sub` the token must have: exact, or a prefix ending in `*` (never `*` alone).

tenant.description: Azure only: the Entra tenant id or domain.

goal.description: `pipeline` and `check`: what the pipeline or check should achieve.

kind.description:
`logs`, `traces`, `metrics`, `sql`, `dashboard`, `alert_rule`, `issues` (the draft is the
issue list's `q` search text) or `llm` (LLM run filters: `provider:` `model:` `outcome:`
`service:` `prompt:` terms plus Lucene full text).

question.description:
What the user wants, at most 4096 bytes. Optional for `pipeline` (use `goal`) and
`check_repair`.

range.description: Optional time range hint such as `1h`.

samples.description: `pipeline`: up to 50 sample log lines of at most 8 KiB each.

session_id.description: `journey_check`: the replay session to turn into a browser check (`url` overrides its start page).

spec.description:
`dashboard_edit`: the dashboard's current spec; the draft is the whole changed spec, which
the UI saves as a new version (so the change can be undone).

url.description: `check`: the URL the check should exercise.

NoData.description: What an evaluation without data means.

parent.description: The service this one is a dependency of; absent for a root.

cost.description: Cost of the node for the period, in the unit you want back (for example USD).

recommendation.description:
`{kind: raise_for, for_s}`, `{kind: add_inhibit, parent_rule}` or
`{kind: pause_route, pause_s}`.

data.description:
Rules with alerts in the window, noisiest first (alerts divided by ack rate, floored at
0.1), at most 50. `suggestion` holds `pause` and/or `widen_for`; nothing is applied.

flaps_available.description: False when flap counts could not be read from `ClickHouse` (flaps are then 0).

merge_candidates.description:
Open issues whose titles are near-identical: merge the sources into the target with
`POST /issues/{target}/merge`; `split` undoes it.

text.description: 1 to 4000 characters.

cell.description:
One cell as in the notebook spec (`type`, `id` and its fields); the whole notebook is
validated again with it.
Cell the comment is about; none comments on the notebook.

text.description: 1 to 2000 bytes, not only whitespace.

acknowledged_at.description:
A page notification: when the page it carried was acknowledged (null until then, and for
other kinds).

opened_at.description: A page notification: when the page it carried was first opened (null until then).

opened_via.description: Where: `app` (a push tapped in the mobile app) or `web`.

preview.description: First 200 characters of what the message says (summary or text); not the rendered body.

receiver_id.description: Null once the receiver was deleted.

resolved.description: True for a recovery notification (an `alert` that carries only resolved alerts, none firing); its `preview` reads "<rule name> recovered". `kind` stays `alert`.

keep_caller.description: The org opted out of masking the caller number in call history.

webhook_path.description: The notifier path the number's voice webhook must post to.

auth_token.description: Replaces the sealed token; omit to keep it.

governed.description: An agent policy names this agent (or the service, when there is no agent name).

host.description: `host.name` of the resource; empty when the SDK does not send it.

sdk.description: Instrumentation scope of the spans (the SDK).

egress_ips.description:
The addresses the runner's checks come from; customers allowlist these. At most 20, each a
valid IP; empty means unknown.

old_host.description: The deprecated host the key last sent to.

data.description: Keys seen on a deprecated host in the last 30 days, newest first; empty when none.

reminder_min.description: Minutes before a shift starts to send the reminder, 0 to 1440 (default 15).

OnError.description: What an evaluation error means for a group.

created.description: Entries created (or that would be, on a dry run).

OpenCanaryDto.description: A canary in progress: the monitor runs every 10 s until `until_ms`, results flagged `canary`.

deploy_event_id.description: The deploy marker that opened it; null for a manual canary without one.

base_rev.description: The revision the edits were made against (the last one this editor has seen).

client.description: This editor session's id; the stream echoes it on the logged operations.

ops.description: Up to 100 edits, applied in order (each made on the result of the one before).

has_byo_key.description: The key itself is never returned.

model_source.description:
Where model calls get their key: `byo` (the org's own), `platform` (the operator's) or
`none` (AI cannot run until the org adds a key).

byo_base_url.description: `https` endpoint of an Anthropic-compatible gateway; must resolve to public addresses.

byo_key.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the stored key.

policy.description: The settings policy pushed to members.

oneOf.description: `null` = no plan, everything unlimited.

caller_ip_allowed.description: Would the allowlist admit this very request? False tells a locked-out admin why.

default_role.description: Role given to members added without one (`project_admin`, `engineer` or `read_only`).

usage_alerts.description: Email the org admins once at 80 % and once at 100 % of a plan limit per period (default true).

default_role.description: `project_admin`, `engineer` or `read_only`; applied to members added without a role.

ip_allowlist.description: CIDRs (at most 50, host bits zero); an empty list lifts the restriction.

usage_alerts.description: `false` turns the 80 % and 100 % plan-limit emails off.

active_series.description:
Series seen in the last hour; null when `ClickHouse` is not configured or the org-wide
view is listed.

overage_bytes.description: Consumption plans only: bytes over the plan allowance for the range.

OverLimitStrategy.description: What happens to a label value longer than `max_label_value_length`.

OverlayLink.description:
A ranked attribute that belongs to a correlation group: the UI overlays `link_signals` of the
same `attribute = value` next to the hit.

Overrides.description: Datadog-parity CI overrides. All optional; recorded on the run so a build can be reproduced.

locations.description: Run only these locations (empty: the monitor's own locations).

retries.description: Retries per monitor for this run (overrides the monitor's own).

start_url.description: Replace the first navigation of each monitor with this URL (e.g. a PR preview).

oneOf.description: Rewrite every navigation URL by replacing `from` with `to`.

paths_total.description: Distinct in-app frame paths of the issues' newest events.

suggestions.description: Up to 3 owners for each of the 10 busiest unowned directories.

truncated.description: True when only the 1000 busiest issues were read.

codeowners.description:
A repository CODEOWNERS file, at most 256 KiB; its `@org/team` owners become `#team`
suggestions.

text.description:
One rule per line: `path:<glob> | module:<glob> | url:<glob> | tag:<key>=<glob>`, then
owners (`#team-slug` or a user email). The last matching rule wins; `#` starts a comment.

The whole rules text, at most 64 KiB. A bad line is refused with its line number. One rule
per line: `<type>:<glob> <owner> [<owner>...]` with type `path`, `module`, `url` or
`tag` (`tag:<key>=<glob>`). An owner is `#team-slug` (a team of the project's org or a
catalog team) or a user email such as `alice@example.com`; a bare `@user` handle is not
accepted. Example: `path:src/billing/* #payments alice@example.com`.

commits.description: The author's commits under `dir` (0 for CODEOWNERS).

rule.description: The rule line to append, e.g. `path:src/billing/* #payments`.

owners.description:
Owners of the last matching rule (`#team` or an email); empty without a match, when the
service catalog's owner team applies.

rules.description: How many rules the text has.

text.description: Rules to try; the saved rules when absent.

url.description: The request URL.

dashboard.description:
`created` or `unchanged` when the install also ran for an enable (the manifest's
dashboard); null for a plain `:install-pack`.

inhibit_rules.description: Inhibition rules the pack owns after the install.

oneOf.description:
The logs pipeline attached to the project's logs pipeline; absent when the integration
has no logs.

minutes.description: `:silence` only: hold the escalation this many minutes (1 to 1440, default 60).

note.description: Resolution note; required to resolve when the project's `require_resolve_note` is set.

incident_id.description: The triage incident a page by service name declared (create response only).

PageViewVitals.description: The vitals of one page view; a metric the page view did not report is null.

first_ts_ns.description: Start of the page view's first vital, unix ns.

navigation_id.description: Client navigation id; empty when the SDK sent none (the page view is then grouped by URL).

rating.description: Worst rating of the reported metrics: `good`, `needs_improvement` or `poor`; empty when none.

PagingCarrierCredentials.description:
The carrier's credentials. Write-only: sealed, never returned. Which fields a kind needs:
`twilio` `account_sid` + `auth_token`; `telnyx` `api_key` + `public_key` (the base64 Ed25519
webhook key) and, for calls, `application_id` (the `TeXML` application); `vonage` `api_key` +
`api_secret` + `signature_secret` and, for calls, `application_id` + `private_key` (PEM).

base_url.description: Origin of a Twilio-compatible API other than the carrier's default.

from.description: The number pages are sent from (E.164).

inbound_path.description: Notifier path for the carrier's voice (gather) and inbound-SMS webhooks.

max_per_minute.description: Sends per minute through this carrier (per notifier replica).

priority.description: 1 is tried first; 2 takes over when 1 fails with a retryable error.

status_path.description: Notifier path for the carrier's delivery-status webhooks.

base_url.description: `null` returns to the carrier's default API origin.

oneOf.description: Replaces all credentials (complete for the kind); omit to keep them.

user_code.description: The code the app shows; case, spaces and the dash are ignored.

label.description: The device's name, shown when approving and as the token name (at most 100 characters).

device_code.description: Secret: keep it on the device, send it only to `:token`.

user_code.description: Shown to the person, entered in the web app.

token.description: A personal access token for `Authorization: Bearer`. Returned once.

phi.description: Trend damping; 1.0 is the undamped limit.

parent.description: A cataloged service; `null` makes this service a root.

PartitionLag.description: One partition of a destination as one consumer group reads it.

consumer_group.description: `messaging.consumer.group.name` (empty when the client does not report it).

lag_p50_s.description: Publish to receive time of the messages, in seconds (p50, p95, max).

partition.description: `messaging.destination.partition.id` (empty when the client does not report it).

oneOf.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

oneOf.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

plan.description: The JSON `EXPLAIN` output: PostgreSQL (`[{"Plan": {...}}]`) or MySQL (`{"query_block": {...}}`).

plan_changed.description: This shape is new for the statement while an older one was recorded.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the plan shape (costs left out).

total_cost.description: The planner's total cost, when the plan carries one.

PatCreated.description: Returned once, by create. `token` is never stored or shown again.

prefix.description: Not secret: identifies the token in lists.

allowed_cidrs.description:
Replace the credential's own allowlist (at most 50 CIDRs or addresses; empty: any), so a
live key can be pinned without minting a new one (W28).
The gateway judges the TCP peer address; only when that peer is in `WT_TRUSTED_PROXIES`
does it take the right-most `X-Forwarded-For` hop that is not itself a trusted proxy.
Behind a reverse proxy, list the proxy there, or every client looks like the proxy. A
client on the gateway's own host arrives from the proxy or container-bridge address,
not the host's public IP, so pin it to that address.

spec.description: A different spec creates a new version.

allow_localhost.description: Let publishable keys list `http://localhost:*` origins (default false).

retention_days.description: Signal name to days (1 to 3650), e.g. `{"logs": 14}`.

service_silent_rules.description:
Keep a managed "<service> stopped reporting" rule per service (default true). `false` deletes
those rules and stops upkeep from recreating them.

PatchQualityGateRequest.description:
Fields to change; omitted ones keep their value. `conditions` replaces the whole set, and an
empty `service` clears it.

ignore_count.description:
With `ignored`: reopen after this many more events (1 to 1000000); with
`ignore_window_s`, after this many events within one window instead.

ignore_until.description: With `ignored`: RFC 3339 time in the future after which the issue reopens on its next event.

ignore_user_count.description: With `ignored`: reopen once this many more users are affected (1 to 1000000).

ignore_window_s.description:
With `ignored` and `ignore_count`: the window in seconds (60 to 2592000), "archive until
it occurs N times in T".

priority.description: `high`, `medium` or `low`. Sticky: the worker no longer changes it.

resolved_in_commit.description:
With `resolved`: fixed by this commit (7 to 64 hex characters); the first release that
ships it becomes the resolving release.

resolved_in_next_release.description:
With `resolved`: fixed in the next release created for the project; events until then do
not reopen it.

resolved_in_release.description:
With `resolved`: version of the release that fixes it. A later release seeing the issue is
evidence of a regression; without it the reopen is labelled a hypothesis.

substatus.description:
With `ignored`: `archived_forever` (default), `archived_until_escalating` or
`archived_until_condition_met`. An `ignore_until` or `ignore_count` sets its own.

retention_days.description: Signal name to days (1 to 3650), e.g. `{"logs": 14}`; other signals are unchanged.

folder.description: Folder path; an empty string takes the query out of its folder.

oneOf.description: Replace the authentication header.

slug.description: New slug: 2 to 40 chars of a-z, 0-9 and '-'; 409 when taken in the org.

body.description: Validated like on create. The channel kind cannot change.

covered.description: A browser check opens both, in this order.

transitions.description: Times users went from `from` straight to `to`.

addr.description: Empty when the router did not answer.

rtt_ms.description: Mean round trip of the answered probes.

add_suspect_author.description: Also page the author of the suspect change when they are a project member.

oneOf.description: Hold pages below a severity until a named time interval is active.

Take this path only once the policy has paged at least `count` times in the last
`window_min` minutes (this page included): an alert-storm path.
Active only inside this named time interval.

Hold the first level until the AI investigation the alert started has finished (or
`timeout_min` passed), then page with its summary and first hypothesis attached.

PathwayHop.description: One producer to consumer hop of a queue pathway.

latency_p50_ms.description: Producer span end to consumer span start, in milliseconds.
