Write-only: the Seolyticize API key, or the webhook signing secret (16 to 256 bytes).
Required the first time; omit to keep the stored one.

site_id.description: Required for `seolyticize`: the site the vitals belong to (1 to 128 characters of `A-Za-z0-9._-`).

url.description:
An https URL that is not a private address. `seolyticize`: the host (any path is dropped);
`webhook`: the full URL.

window_days.description: Days of vitals each push covers, 1 to 28 (default 7).

extrapolated.description: True when a sampling rule drops events: counts are of the sampled events.

next_cursor.description: Always null: aggregates are not paged.

sample_rate.description: Product of the enabled sampling rules' rates (1 when none).

affected_symbols.description: Symbols the advisory names as affected (library findings).

profile_functions.description: Profile frames that matched the advisory.

profile_share.description:
Share (0 to 1) of the service's CPU the vulnerable code is on the stack for, from its
continuous profiles; 0 when not seen or not checked.

profile_window_days.description: Days of profiles checked; 0 means the service has no profiles.

reachability_evidence.description: Human sentence for the profile evidence, empty when there is none to report.

reachability_level.description: `reference` when advisory symbols were matched against symbols the service uses, else `import`.

trace_id.description: Trace id (runtime findings) in lowercase hex, else empty.

vuln_ref.description: Advisory, SAST rule or taint vulnerability type.

VulnNewQuery.description:
A `vulnerability_new` rule over `vulnerabilities_v1` (D2): Code Security findings first seen in
the window, one group per service. `code` (SAST) findings arrive per upload, so by default only
`library` (SCA) and `runtime` (IAST) findings count; set `types` to override.

min_severity.description: Only findings at or above this severity (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`).

service.description: Only this service.

active.description:
Same as `in_effect`, kept for compatibility. It is not an on/off switch: a window has no
enabled flag, it exists until deleted.

in_effect.description: An occurrence of the window (from `rrule`, `tz` and `duration_s`) is running at this moment.

WindowKind.description: How an SLO's budget period is cut.

oneOf.description:
What the window does while it runs (default `mute`). `mute`: results are recorded as
usual and alerts whose labels match `scope.matchers` are muted. `skip_checks`: the engine
does not run the monitors in `scope.monitors`, so they record no results and raise no
alert. `mark_checks`: the monitors in `scope.monitors` run and their results are flagged
`maintenance`: they never alert, never change the monitor's state and are excluded from
uptime.

scope.description: What the window covers. `scope.monitors` takes `mon_` ids (a bare UUID is accepted too).

tz.description: IANA zone the rule is evaluated in (default `UTC`).

matchers.description:
Mode `mute` only: an alert is muted when every matcher matches its labels (AND). An empty
list matches no alert (it never means "everything"), and mode `mute` rejects it; in the
other modes the matchers are ignored.

monitors.description:
The monitors that `skip_checks` and `mark_checks` act on. Input takes `mon_` ids or bare
UUIDs; responses show `mon_` ids.

slos.description: SLO ids, excluded from burn while the window runs (R3).

WizardBody.description:
Give `log_pattern` or `trace_attribute` (with `service`) to create an SLO and its metrics;
give neither to get proposals.

log_pattern.description: Bad events are log lines containing this text (at most 200 characters).

name.description: Creation only; default `<service> <pattern or attribute>`.

service.description: Proposals: one service only. Creation: the service the SLO belongs to (required).

proposals.description: Proposals from the last 30 days; empty when an SLO was created.

owner_id.description: The user its actions run as: whoever saved it last.

enabled.description: Default true.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters, unique in the project.

steps.description:
1 to 50 steps. Actions: `send_notification`, `http_request`, `create_incident`,
`update_incident`, `add_timeline_note`, `page`, `create_jira_issue`, `create_slack_channel`,
`post_slack_message`, `run_query`, `start_postmortem`, `wait` (`seconds` 1 to 900) and
`trigger_workflow` (chains at most 3 deep). A step may repeat with `loop` (`over` a JSON
path, `over_expr` a CEL list or `until` a CEL condition with `max_iterations`); action
`loop` runs `loop.steps` per iteration. `${$.json.path}` in a string parameter is
replaced from the event payload. The caller needs the permission of every action.

trigger.description:
`events` (1 to 20 of `alert.{firing,resolved,acknowledged}`, `issue.{created,regressed,
resolved,assigned}`, `incident.{declared,status_changed,severity_changed,field_changed,
resolved}`, `deployment.created`, `monitor.{down,up}`) and optional `conditions`: an
expression of `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `matches` (RE2), `and`, `or` and
`not` over `JSONPath` into the event payload (at most 4 KiB, 16 levels).

request.description: `{kind: http_request, url, method, headers, body}` or `{kind: script, script, args}`.

definition.description: `{trigger, steps}`; `REPLACE_ME` marks values to fill in.

hours.description: Responder hours inferred from timeline activity sessions.

truncated.description: More than 200 pods: only the first 200 were checked.

id.description: Also the `client_id` the workload sends to `POST /v1/oauth/token`.

actor_label.description: Who saved it; becomes the commit's `Co-authored-by` trailer.

kind.description: The manifest kind (`Dashboard`, `AlertRule`, `Slo`, ...), as `wtctl export` writes it.

name.description: The object's manifest key.

source_id.description: The source; or give `managed_by` (the object's `managed-by` label).

bearer.description: API key (`wtk_`), service account key (`wta_`) or personal access token (`wtu_`) in `Authorization: Bearer`.

browserKey.description: Browser key (`wtp_`), safe to embed in pages. Valid only on browser telemetry endpoints and on `GET /v1/auth/key` (self-introspection); management routes answer 403.

ingestKey.description: Ingestion key (`wti_`). Accepted on the ingest endpoints of the edge and on `GET /v1/auth/key` (the key reads its own record: no secret, its scopes and project). Management routes answer 403.
